description: ## This is not a normal software engineering role At ClearFeed, using AI to build software is not optional. Every engineer is expected to use AI every day — to understand code, write code, review code, debug issues, design product flows, generate tests, write docs, explore APIs, and ship faster. We expect you to be comfortable using tools like Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar AI tools as part of your default engineering workflow. If you do not know how to use AI effectively to write code, debug issues, understand unfamiliar systems, and improve your own engineering output, **please do not apply**. We are looking for engineers who can use AI as leverage — while still bringing strong judgment, ownership, and engineering taste. AI can write a lot of the first draft. You are responsible for the final result. ## What we are building ClearFeed is building an AI-first support platform for modern teams working in Slack and Microsoft Teams. Our product connects conversations, tickets, knowledge bases, engineering tools, CRMs, and AI agents so companies can resolve customer and internal requests faster. Our engineers work on real product problems: * How should an AI agent understand a support conversation? * When should it answer automatically, and when should it ask a human? * How do we safely connect Slack, Teams, Zendesk, Jira, GitHub, Linear, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other tools? * How do we make AI workflows observable, debuggable, and trustworthy? * How do we ship fast without creating chaos for customers? ## What you will do You will take ambiguous customer problems and turn them into working software. That may include API design, backend logic, database changes, Slack/Teams workflows, AI-agent behavior, product UX, tests, monitoring, and deployment. You will be expected to: * Use AI tools heavily while writing and reviewing code. * Use AI to create first-pass designs, specs, implementation plans, tests, and docs. * Build backend services using TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, and cloud infrastructure. * Work on AI-agent features involving LLMs, RAG, tool-calling, structured outputs, evals, guardrails, and observability. * Own features end to end: idea → design → implementation → testing → release → production debugging. * Debug production issues and improve the system after every incident. * Improve our engineering system itself: better prompts, better internal tools, better test generation, better review loops, better deployment workflows. * Move fast, but stay accountable for what ships. ## What “AI-native” means here We do not mean “vibe code and hope it works.” We mean: * You can use AI to move significantly faster. * You can use AI to write, refactor, test, and debug code. * You can review AI-generated code critically. * You understand that AI is often confidently wrong. * You can use AI for product thinking, but you do not outsource judgment. * You can ship faster without lowering quality. * You can explain your decisions clearly to humans. The best engineers in the next decade will not be the ones who manually type the most code. They will be the ones who combine product judgment, technical depth, and AI leverage to ship high-quality software faster than traditional teams. ## What we are looking for You may be a good fit if: * You are already using AI coding tools daily. * You are faster today than you were one year ago because of AI. * You have strong software fundamentals and do not blindly trust generated code. * You can work across backend, product, integrations, and basic frontend when needed. * You care about customer experience, not just clean abstractions. * You enjoy working in small teams with high ownership. * You can take a problem statement and come back with a working solution. * You are comfortable with ambiguity. * You like shipping. * You are curious, direct, and low-ego. ## Bonus points We will pay extra attention if you have: * Built something real using AI agents. * Used Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, v0, Lovable, Replit, or similar tools seriously. * Shipped a side project using AI. * Built integrations with Slack, Teams, Zendesk, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce, or HubSpot. * Worked on support, developer tools, workflow automation, or B2B SaaS products. * Written about your engineering work. * Open-source contributions or visible proof of work. ## How we evaluate We use AI in our hiring process for the same reason we use it in engineering: it helps everyone move faster and spend time where human judgment matters most. The first step is a short AI-led interview of around 15 minutes. It helps us understand your background, your experience, and how you think about building software. After that, you will have three technical discussions with our team: * Problem solving + debugging * Problem solving * System design We want to understand how you reason, how you debug, how you make trade-offs, and how well you can combine engineering fundamentals with AI tools to build reliable software faster. ## What you get We want engineers to have the tools, support, and environment to do their best work. ### Flexible AI Credits You will get flexible AI credits and access to the tools you need to build faster — Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, or whatever genuinely helps you ship better software. We do not want engineers hesitating before using AI because of subscription limits or tool access. ### Health and medical support You get comprehensive medical insurance, along with **free doctor consultations**. We are a small team, but we want to be thoughtful about health, family, and emergencies. You should not have to figure everything out on your own when something medical comes up. ### Sports and team activities We sponsor badminton and cricket games for the team. Not mandatory forced-fun activities. Just real sports, real games, and a good way to spend time with people outside tickets, PRs, and production issues. ## How to apply Apply here or send your resume to jobs@clearfeed.ai with: * Your LinkedIn, GitHub, or resume. * One thing you have built that you are proud of. * A short note on how you use AI in your engineering workflow. * Optional: a Loom/video/walkthrough of something you built.

description: # Job Description: Quickbase Application Developer & Python Engineer **Company:** Insight Consultants **Role:** Quickbase Application Developer & Python Engineer **Employment Type:** Full-time or Contract (based on experience) **Location:** Bangalore, India ## About the Role Insight Consultants is looking for a hands-on developer to manage, maintain, and continuously improve an existing Quickbase application. This role goes beyond application support. We want someone who can understand business requirements, identify opportunities to improve existing processes, develop new functionality, and use Python to build integrations, automate tasks, and extend the application's capabilities. The ideal candidate combines strong Quickbase development skills with Python programming experience and a practical, problem-solving mindset. They should be comfortable working with an existing application, understanding how it works, and progressively making it more efficient, scalable, and user-friendly. ## Key Responsibilities ### 1. Quickbase Application Management - Take ownership of the existing Quickbase application, including its tables, relationships, forms, reports, dashboards, and workflows. - Maintain and troubleshoot existing functionality, resolve issues, and ensure the application operates reliably. - Manage application enhancements, user access, permissions, and configuration changes. - Review the existing application architecture and identify opportunities to improve performance, usability, and maintainability. - Document application structure, business rules, workflows, and technical changes. ### 2. Application Enhancements and Development - Gather and translate business requirements into practical Quickbase solutions. - Develop new features, forms, reports, dashboards, automations, and workflows. - Improve existing business processes by reducing manual work and eliminating unnecessary steps. - Identify gaps in the current application and proactively recommend improvements. - Test enhancements, troubleshoot defects, and implement changes with minimal disruption to existing operations. ### 3. Python Development and Automation - Develop Python scripts and utilities to automate repetitive tasks and business processes. - Build integrations between Quickbase and other applications, APIs, databases, and data sources. - Use Python to perform data validation, transformation, reconciliation, and bulk data processing. - Develop custom functionality where Quickbase's native capabilities are insufficient or where an external service would be more effective. - Write maintainable, reusable, and well-documented code. ### 4. Integrations and Data Management - Work with Quickbase APIs and REST APIs to exchange data with external systems. - Design and maintain reliable data import, export, synchronization, and integration processes. - Monitor data quality, investigate discrepancies, and implement validation and error-handling mechanisms. - Ensure appropriate handling of credentials, access permissions, and sensitive business data. ### 5. Continuous Improvement - Work with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and improvement opportunities. - Evaluate whether a requirement is best addressed through Quickbase configuration, Python development, or integration with another system. - Recommend solutions that improve productivity, reduce errors, and support future business growth. - Maintain technical documentation and communicate progress, issues, and recommendations clearly. ## Required Qualifications - Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining applications using **Quickbase**. - Proficiency in **Python**, including writing scripts, working with data, debugging, and building automation. - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and API integrations. - Understanding of relational databases, data structures, and data relationships. - Experience troubleshooting existing applications and enhancing functionality without disrupting established workflows. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. - Good communication skills and the ability to work independently. ## Preferred Qualifications - Experience with Quickbase pipelines, formula fields, relationships, reports, and application administration. - Experience with Quickbase API integrations and advanced application customization. - Familiarity with SQL and database concepts. - Experience with Git or other version control systems. - Familiarity with cloud platforms, scheduled jobs, and automated deployments. - Experience with data analytics, reporting, workflow automation, or AI-enabled business applications. ## Who We Are Looking For We are looking for a practical, hands-on developer who takes ownership of the application and thinks beyond the immediate task. Someone who asks, "Can this process be made better?" rather than simply implementing the next requested change. The right person will be comfortable working with an existing system, learning its business logic, proposing improvements, and delivering solutions that make a measurable difference to the business.

description: NewStreet is an award-winning fintech building AI-powered platforms that transform how financial institutions operate. Established in 2017 and ISO 9001 & ISO 27001 certified, we serve 170,000+ customers across lending, trade finance and payments, partnering with leading banks across India, the GCC and Southeast Asia. * Financial Times — 7th Fastest-Growing Fintech, Asia Pacific · Deloitte Technology Fast 50 · Aegis Graham Bell Award · World Fintech Awards 2025 · FICCI IBA Best Emerging Technology Platform* **About the Role** Two backend engineers, one into the MiFiX.ai platform team and one into client delivery. You will be writing Python services that handle real financial data for real banks, with a senior engineer reviewing your work closely for the first few months. This is the second rung of the engineering ladder: Graduate Engineer → Software Engineer I → Software Engineer II → Senior Software Engineer. We expect you to already write code that works; what you will learn here is writing code that survives production, review and an auditor. **Key Responsibilities** Build and maintain API endpoints. FastAPI services against PostgreSQL, to the team's existing patterns rather than your own. Write the tests with the code. Not afterwards, not 'when there is time'. Tests are part of the pull request. Handle data carefully. Financial records. Validate inputs, parameterise every query, and never log anything a customer would mind seeing in a log file. Take code review seriously. You will get detailed review. Argue when you disagree, change it when you are wrong, and do not repeat the same correction twice. Debug your own defects. Reproduce, find the cause, fix the cause — and say what the cause was rather than 'it works now'. Document what you build. A short README or endpoint note so the next person does not have to read the whole module. **What You Bring** * 1–3 years writing Python professionally. * FastAPI or Flask exposure — you have built and run an HTTP service. * SQL and PostgreSQL basics: joins, indexes, and why a query might be slow. * Git as a working tool — branches, pull requests, resolving your own conflicts. * Readable code. Sensible names, small functions, no cleverness for its own sake. * BE / BTech / MCA or equivalent. **What Would Be Great to Have** * Pandas or scikit-learn. * Docker, and any exposure to a CI pipeline. * Async Python and SQLAlchemy 2.0. * Financial-services data exposure. * AI-assisted development tools used with judgement — we use them, and we * expect you to review what they produce. **Tech Stack** Backend: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic Data: PostgreSQL, Redis Tooling: Git, Docker, pytest, CI pipelines Cloud: AWS basics — you will learn the rest here **Apply:** careers@newstreettech.com
